title: Every home should always keep one set on hand for unexpected guests!
text: Every home should always keep one set on hand for unexpected guests!. This is a great party set. It has everything you need with cups, napkins and plates for a small get together or party. I actually have bought an additional set of these to just keep in my pantry in the random event I have people over I will be ready. Surprisingly, the plates are very sturdy and can hold up to wet/hot foods. The cups are ok (I mean, I tend to use larger solo cups if we are drinking cocktails) however, these are good for coffee or soft drinks. I highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Havercamp Iconic Turquoise & Sweetheart Locket Tableware for 16 Guests! This Picturesque set includes 16 ea. Large Paper Plates & Luncheon Napkins
features: SPOT ON BEAUTIFUL TURQUOISE BLUE COLOR WITH SIGNATURE PURE WHITE SATIN BOW AND HEART SHAPED LOCKET ON CHAIN! It’s What A Girl Wants for her Party; setting an upscale, branded, and sophisticated tone! The Favorite Blue Box brings a premium edge to every event.
16 FABULOUS PLATES – Lg. 9 in. Square Plates; Sturdy enough for the main course at your party. Splendid white satin bow with the Silver heart shaped locket on beautiful Robin’s Egg Blue.
16 ELEGANT NAPKINS - High Resolution print matches the plate.
Perfect for Luncheons, Wedding events, Bridal Showers, Birthdays, Balls, Prom, Sweet 16 and many more Soirees.

FAVORITE BLUE BOX COLLECTION - These square plates are a part of Havercamp's Favorite Blue Box Collection which also features the same design and vibe. It includes variety of partyware such as dessert plates and luncheon napkins.
